name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 9 visits over 46 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 48 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 46 hours starting 2025-10-23, at wavelengths from 1.24 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 2 moving objects.
